name: 11768 · Northport, NY
findings: ZIP 11768 (Northport) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11768 (Northport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11768 (Northport) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
